description: This Java interface defines API endpoints for managing documents within the Fineract project, including creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating documents via RESTful HTTP methods. It was generated by OpenAPI Generator and manually edited for specific fixes.

classes.name: DocumentsApiFixed
classes.description: Interface defining REST API endpoints for document management in Fineract, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document using multipart form upload, requiring entity type, entity ID, file, and optional name and description.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document by entity type, entity ID, and document ID.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads the binary file associated with a document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of a specific document.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents for a given entity.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document with optional new file, name, or description.
